defects.summary: /reports and /analytics are near-identical pages, reached from different chrome (top bar says Reports, sidebar says Analytics).
/settings/billing and /account/billing duplicate billing; only the second shows invoices.
/settings/team and /admin/users list the same team members.
/customers/archive has no inbound links.
Customer is split across /customers/[id], /customers/[id]/notes (duplicates the notes tab) and top-level /customer-activity?id=.
Sidebar links /insights, which has no page and no redirect.
Breadcrumbs link /settings (and /admin, /account), which have no page.
/dashboard -> /home -> /overview is a two-hop redirect chain; / also redirects in a page.
A customer has two addresses: /customers?selected=ID (drawer) and /customers/ID.
Middleware redirects to /login without the original path; after sign-in the user lands on /overview, losing the deep link.
Top bar uses prefix match, sidebar exact match: on /customers/1 the top bar highlights Customers and the sidebar highlights nothing.
Top bar and sidebar both carry Overview/Customers/Orders; plus Team and Billing are in the sidebar and Admin in the top bar.
Under 768px both the top bar nav and sidebar are hidden with no replacement; mobile users have no primary navigation.
Breadcrumbs echo raw URL segments (ids like '1', route words like 'settings').
Customer tabs router.push ?tab=, so Back steps through tabs.
Orders status filter is useState only; lost on refresh, Back and the detail page's back button.
Customer drawer opens with router.replace, so Back leaves /customers instead of closing the drawer.
Note draft lives in a provider above [id]; text typed for one customer appears on the next customer.
(app)/template.jsx remounts on every navigation, so the dismissed banner returns.
Order detail '← Orders' uses router.push('/orders'): adds a history entry, resets filter and scroll; browser Back then returns to the detail page.
